name: Strands Agents
summary: A Strands Agent on the Anthropic model provider; each MCP server is an MCPClient tool provider the agent starts and stops itself, plus one @tool.
notes: Sends the system prompt verbatim and streams. Prompt caching is off by default in AnthropicModel (cache_config unset), so every turn pays full input price; left at the default. max_turns maps to the per-call limits={'turns': n}. No sampling params or forced tool_choice, so no shims. MCPClient takes a transport factory (mcp 2.x streamable_http_client / stdio_client); the Agent starts and stops the clients it is given.
